qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION. Source categories imply no compile/runtime pass, race-detector result or production qualification.

Grant fixture directly starts upstream server.NewServer with loopback TCP clients and single-replica temporary file-backed JetStream. It does not call natscell.Start, prove quorum/cluster failover, restart/crash durability, or validate synthetic request signature bytes.
IMDS tests are fake HTTPDoer response/request contracts. Sampler filesystem test injects SystemView and reaches no statfs, /proc or cgroup reader.

Trailing-root-data target is local rootPEM validation; seed/key/certificate file reads are incidental setup. Role test has real TCP JWT authorization but no live TerraBase, TLS transport handshake or interregion link.

Role denied-bucket calls reuse one one-second context and assert only nonnil errors; no specific authorization error is required there. Later refused-subject helper requires asynchronous permission errors; no runtime outcome or timing is inferred.

Tombstone different-terminal-op is invalid ULID and rejected before I/O; valid foreign-operation takeover is not established by that block. Distinct local Claim provenance guard remains a unit obligation.

Concurrent aggregator test asserts eventual node count only, ignores per-call errors/values and cannot source-prove race freedom or throughput. Silent contributor test is deterministic in-memory time/value behavior.
All negative, trust, retry, no-write, byte/revision preservation and local-validation obligations retained. No test deletion/retirement, ledger mutation or completion/count promotion.

findings.detail: Lines139-141 use different-terminal-op, not a canonical uppercase 26-character ULID. grant.go242-244 and entityid/id.go32-44 prove pre-KV rejection; no different valid operation conflict coverage is credited.
